==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Nicknamed "OP-timus" for his explosive play with {{ci|Kassadin}} against [[ahq e-Sports Club]] in [[GPL|GPL Summer 2014]].
*He is also known as "Cường 7 Núi" - loosely translated to "Cường of the Seven Mountains" - after not playing professionally and turning to being a streamer. This can be considered his "for fun" streaming persona where he frequently and jokingly claims "GAM cần anh" (GAM ([[GAM Esports]]) needs me) following his "great plays" on streams.
*He is also known as the Pentakill thief saint for deliberatingly denies his teammates' Pentakills.
